cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you authorize your sister to bring?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A date. Did you invite my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right, you can open the invitations. First, did you name anyone she couldn't bring?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. My ex. I sent you both the same message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read me the time on that message, then open the invitations beside it.
